corrections.title: GAC naming cleanup: five-group defence and counter display-name identity correction
corrections.rationale: Owner-completed naming review (issue #56). Renames 19 matchup defence keys (8 in 5v5, 11 in 3v3) and the 4 dependent defence-team/composition keys, and amends 8 counter display names, so that each displayed identity names the intended Galactic Legend or variant unambiguously and the same defence uses the same name in 5v5 and 3v3. Defence renames are exact old-key RETIRE plus new-key ADD because the stable key is name + mode; counter rows are AMEND on the stable Counter_ID. One owner-approved functional correction is included: counter PHOENIX required becomes [HERA_SYNDULLA, CAPTAIN_REX]. No counter is added, removed, reordered or retiered; no tier, bannerScore, undersize, note, threat, composition unit, Character_ID, externalId, scoring, score meaning, board configuration or FLEET row changes.

evidence.supports: Exact owner-agreed OLD -> NEW names for the 19 matchup rows, 8 counter display names, the PHOENIX required correction, the 4 dependent defence-team/composition keys, and Option C (no saved-board migration or alias).

Owner clarification: the existing Hondo defence in 5v5 and 3v3 always meant Galactic Legend Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka; CR-2026-10-10-02-P01 (3v3 Add) is withdrawn; units.json HONDO_OHNAKA is the original Hondo and must not be renamed.
Owner direction: rename rather than add, preserving counters, order, tiers, bannerScore, undersize and notes; renames are RETIRE + ADD inside one atomic owner-approved change set.

evidence.publisher: gac-helper catalogue source at the baseline commit
evidence.supports: Existing Character_IDs referenced by the unchanged compositions and by the amended PHOENIX required list exist: HERA_SYNDULLA (Hera Syndulla) and CAPTAIN_REX (Captain Rex); BO_KATAN_MANDALOR is named Bo-Katan (Mand'alor); CT_7567_REX is CT-7567 "Rex".

provenance.conditions: Display-name identity correction across 5v5 and 3v3 matchups, counters, defence-teams (ANY) and 3v3 defence compositions; FLEET unaffected. Not a matchup-performance claim: no omicron, datacron or game-version condition is asserted, and existing grades are carried over unchanged.
provenance.confidence: High for the identities: every new name is an explicit owner decision recorded in #56/#37 and each old row was matched exactly once on the baseline with no new-name collision. The proposal makes no claim about whether the carried-over tiers, banner scores or notes are correct against the named Galactic Legends.
provenance.limitations: Option C (owner): no saved-board migration or alias. Saved Round opponent boards, My Board and defence templates that hold a renamed old name keep it and show '<old name> (saved; not in current catalogue)' with no counters (and, on My Board, no defence composition) until the owner manually reselects the new name; choosing the new opponent team clears any manual remaining-banners override (scores, attempts and clears are not reset). Existing frozen defenceSnapshot values stay unchanged. Rollback to the old names needs the same manual reselection. Carried-over grades (for example 5v5 Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka CERE/BAYLAN/SLKR) are not revalidated here and remain backlog work. Making CAPTAIN_REX required for PHOENIX means Round availability now also needs an available Captain Rex.

runtimeImpact.5v5: 8 defence keys renamed in Counters and Round pickers (Hondo, Maul, Finn, Bo-Katan Mandalore, Ahsoka Tano, Rey, Leia Organa, Cere UFU); counters, order, tiers, banners, undersize and notes identical. Ahsoka Tano (GL) keeps HIGH threat via the renamed ANY row. Picker sort position changes with the new names.
runtimeImpact.3v3: 11 defence keys renamed (Hondo, Mauldalorians, Rex, Finn, Bo-Katan Mandalore, Ahsoka Tano, Rey, Leia Organa, Emperor Palp with Vader Dual's End, Geonosian, Cere UFU); counters identical. CT-7567 Rex, Finn (Zorii Resistance) and Rey (GL) keep their exact 3v3 compositions; Ahsoka Tano (GL) keeps HIGH threat via ANY.
runtimeImpact.counters: 8 attacking counter display names change in every mode (BO_KATAN_MANDALORE, LEIA, BAD_BATCH, VEERS, PHOENIX, CERE, CERE_SK, MAUL); IDs unchanged. PHOENIX now requires Hera Syndulla and Captain Rex.
runtimeImpact.roundAvailability: PHOENIX is available only when both HERA_SYNDULLA and CAPTAIN_REX are available, and now commits Captain Rex. Saved boards/templates holding an old defence name show '(saved; not in current catalogue)' with no counters or composition until manually reselected (Option C, no migration); reselecting an opponent team clears a manual remaining-banners override; frozen defenceSnapshot unchanged.
runtimeImpact.scoring: none — checked: scoring.json, score-meanings.json and board-config.json untouched; banner scores carried over unchanged.
runtimeImpact.strategicReserve: none — checked: no counter's strategicReserve value changes.
